alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 19 at 1:05PM PST until November 19 at 7:00PM PST by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* CHANGES...Snow amounts reflect remaining accumulations.

* WHAT...Snow. Additional snow accumulations up to 2 inches below
5000 feet, with 2 to 4 inches above 5000 feet, including foothill
areas and Virginia City.

* WHERE...Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM PST this evening.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Thursday evening commute.
alerts.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions
for the state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.
